purpose: Solve retained reach/walk construction at explicit query times, accumulate walking root travel and measure decoded contact/deformation.

properties.path: new JSON output path outside the protected live machine body
properties.recipe: character recipe with a body-relative performance contract
properties.clip: declared reach or walk clip name
properties.times: 2..1024 increasing nonnegative seconds; walk can continue across cycles
properties.feet: optional end-joint to form-part mapping for whole-foot contact checks

limitations: Uses the caller's elapsed time, not a hidden wall clock. Root travel is already included in the pose.
Solves declared two-bone paths at query time. No terrain sensing, dynamics, balance, collision or arbitrary rig retargeting.
Exported GLB clips remain baked; continuous contact requires this retained-recipe controller. Normal GLB playback does not execute it.
Measurements cover listed times and decoded vertices, not unsampled extrema, shaded normals or artistic quality.
